system.description:
AUDITORY FEAR SAVE UNLIVING-GHOST

Prerequisites Level 8, Essence Attacks

Your grief tears loose as a keening cry that freezes courage in the living.

Action: 2 AP

You emit a sorrowful wail affecting creatures within a 60-foot radius that can hear you. Each affected creature must attempt a Will save. On a failure, it becomes frightened 2. On a fumble, it becomes frightened 4. On a success, the creature is immune to your Wail of the Departed for 1 minute.

Grants Wail of the Departed as an innate spell-like (2 AP, at will): creatures within 60 feet that can hear you roll Will against your Level DC — Failure frightened 2, Fumble frightened 4, Success immune to your Wail for 1 minute.
